title: PINARELLO MY26 F5 105 Di2 current specifications
notes: Current exact MY26 F5 105 Di2 manufacturer page specifies Shimano 105 Di2 2x12, a Torayca T700 UD frame, and 32 mm maximum tire width. Pinarello describes the revised head tube and Aero Keel bottom-bracket area as stiffness improvements but publishes no deflection value. The generic retained mainland card does not expose enough option detail to inherit this build weight.
